column2: Open POs are purchase orders with remaining open balance at cutover. Include only POs with Open_Amount > 0. Validate with: python workday_financial_validator.py open_purchase_orders this_file.csv 3
PO_Number + PO_Line_Number together form the unique key. Multi-line POs require one row per line
Quantity_Ordered: Total quantity on the PO line, not remaining quantity
Open_Amount: The remaining unbilled/unreceived amount. Must be <= Extended_Amount
Supplier_ID: Must exactly match a Supplier_ID from the Supplier Master load
Spend_Category: Must match a valid Workday Spend Category Reference ID in your tenant
Reconciliation check: Sum of Open_Amount = Open PO commitments/encumbrances per legacy system
Load order: Object 9 — load AFTER Supplier Master. Can load in parallel with Open AP Invoices
